import random, re

token = simple_note_token

def search_all(q):
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    out=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=token, query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        if isinstance(resp, dict) and 'notes' in resp:
            items=resp['notes']
        else:
            items=resp
        out.extend(items)
        if len(items) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1
    return out

funny_notes = search_all('funny')
quote_notes = search_all('quote')

print('funny_notes_count', len(funny_notes))
print('quote_notes_count', len(quote_notes))
print('funny_titles', [n.get('title') for n in funny_notes])
print('quote_titles', [n.get('title') for n in quote_notes])

# Extract bullet items that look like quotes lines starting with '- ' and then quote text
# The content includes title and blank lines; quotes are formatted:
#  - quote text
#    by Author
# We'll capture quote text following '- ' up to endline
quotes = []
lines = content.splitlines()
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.strip().startswith('- '):
        q = line.strip()[2:].rstrip()
        # skip if it's just '-' etc
        if q:
            quotes.append(q)
print('quotes_found', len(quotes))
print('first_10', quotes[:10])
print('last_3', quotes[-3:])
selected = random.choice(quotes) if quotes else ''
print('selected', selected)
